description: Rust download manager for Windows with browser integration, video downloads and torrent support.
notes: Extracts the verified Inno Setup payload; Scoop does not run the vendor installer, create its HKCU protocol registrations, enable startup tasks or create vendor shortcuts.
The app stores its settings and download data under %APPDATA%\Ezoo\EzooDownload\data, outside the Scoop directory.
The portable copy is not recognized as an installed copy by the app's updater; update it with scoop update ezoo-download.
